cost_notes: Training includes stage-1 and bias, excludes herding; calibration/evaluation and summary elapsed are overlapping measurements and must not be added together. RSS is sampled, not exact peak. Original checkpoint and progress binaries remain preserved on the experiment drive, identified by SHA256; retained real row IDs are exported.
metric_notes: Final and incremental balanced accuracy; macro-F1 over seen classes; signed best-prior-minus-final recall forgetting over classes introduced before the final task. Mean and sample SD (ddof=1) over five seeds. Each view uses its own stage CMs; no cross-view forgetting.
scope: BiC with the Section192 family-wide common stage-1 override on registered flow-vector single-channel Conv1D inputs, not native packet 10x4 reproduction. Architecture and stage-2 values are explicit engineering defaults. Registered multi-stage tasks and 200 unique TRAIN rows per seen class including Normal replace the paper protocol. Replay and correction rows are persistent without old-class refresh. All five CIC17 cells were newly run under this separate common identity as explicitly authorized by Section192; native results remain untouched historical sensitivity evidence, excluded from this comparison family. Stage1 uses Adam lr0.001 batch256 max(8 full epochs,2000 steps), final iterate, no early stopping or decay. Separate BiC stage2 uses the unchanged explicit engineering default of 200 SGD epochs. S1 four-method Holm family, RQ1, RQ3 and substantive innovation gate remain incomplete.
